    length_y = 1.0  # 1 meter in y-direction
    divisions_x = 20
    divisions_y = 20

    dx = length_x / divisions_x
    dy = length_y / divisions_y

    nodes = []
    for iy in range(divisions_y + 1):
        for ix in range(divisions_x + 1):
            x = ix * dx - length_x/2
            y = iy * dy - length_y/2

    nodes[-divisions_x - 2].SetFixed(True)          # Top-left
